title: RMB: COMPREHENSIVELY BENCHMARKING REWARD MODELS IN LLM ALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (RMB) that specifically evaluates reward models on 'harmlessness' across 12 scenarios. This includes evaluating 'Hate,' which is defined to include demeaning individuals based on 'religious affiliation.' The benchmark also evaluates 'Ethical refusal' as a key feature, and several examples in the appendix deal with illegal or immoral acts, making moral and ethical alignment a central component of the study.
